notes.title: Everafter Falls has received a major content update!

items.text: New quests, new decorations, new cooking recipes and more! Ou, the developer of Everafter Falls, has been working hard on this content update!
If you haven’t played Everafter Falls in a bit, then now is a great time to jump in!
If you would like to read the full patch notes, I’ll put them below.

There are numerous items being added in this update that can be used to spruce up the farm or to help get those last few pesky items in your collection. You can gather these items by crafting them, unlocking them after completing one of the nine new quests, or winning prizes!

There are many new house decorations, new rug/poster decorations, furniture catalogue, plant catalogue, and more. Be sure to check them out and see if any of these items can help elevate your build! Feel free to share your farms and designs in the Everafter Falls Discord!

Also for those who love to collect and catalogue everything, there are a couple items in this update that may help out! I want to highlight two of these items! The Golgen Shroom Terrarium which is a prize item and will give you a 100% chance to get a shroom you haven’t already gotten. The Epic Critter Terrarium lets you breed only insects you haven’t currently found.
Here is the full list of changes for items and decoration
9 new quests
12 new cooking recipes
Trees can now be moved from Aamy’s PC
Farm buildings can now be deleted from Aamy’s PC
Many new house decorations
New Rug/poster decorations
New item - Furniture catalogue (unlocked after new quest)
New item - Plant Catalogue (unlocked after new quest)
New item - Soot Bowl. Show off your own soot puff.
New Item - Fish Bowl. Small fish bowl that displays a single fish.
New item - Shroom Terrarium can be crafted. Produces shrooms, small chance to get a shroom you haven’t already gotten
New Item - Golden Shroom Terrarium. Prize item. 100% chance to get shroom you haven’t already gotten
New item - Rainbow Orb Plus (can only obtained from Brams new quest)
New machine in Brams Workshop - Orb Slot Creator. Can add orb slots to items.
Cherry Blossom Tree can now be obtained as a prize and placed on Farm. Once obtained, more can be purchased from plant catalogue.
New item - Epic Critter Terrarium lets you breed only insects you haven’t currently found. This item can only be obtained after completing Cedric’s rocket.
New craftable item - Dynamic Poster. Works similar to Label Signpost, but is a poster you can hang on walls.
New craftable item - Hedge
New craftable item - Metal fence
New craftable item - Stone slab path
Additional Soot puff prizes/targets
Additional pixie reward targets

There will be a new way to collect pixies in the update which will be really helpful in completing tasks and gathering items. In the Pixie Cave, there will be new red, blue, and green pixie shrines which after the required items are donated to fix them, will generate a pixie every 5 days. These Shrines can also be used to recall all pixies of each color to respective shrines.

We’ve been listening to the feedback of the community and have added a few QOL changes from players can now up to 3 teleportation stones, blue star shows next to any item in crafting menu you haven’t crafted yet, Pip now offers to take all pigeons in your inventory if you have multiple flightless ones, and more!
Here is the full list of QOL changes
Players can now have up to 3 teleportation stones placed down. TPStone price increases with each purchase.
Saplings that can be pulled out and replanted can now be done for trees that grow 1 stage past sapling (although they will turn back into sapling)
Blue star shows next to any item in crafting menu that you have not crafted (to help track the master crafter achievement)
Pip now offers to take all pigeons in your inventory if you have multiple flightless ones.
Potplants are now also placeable outdoors
Tree saplings can now be fished out using rod
List of Pixie Blessings you have will be displayed on Player Stats page after acquiring them.
Soot puff growers now spawn a free soot if empty on a new day (revert)
Increased max Pixie Synergy card eating level from 4 > 6
Increased max Pixie Friendship card eating level from 7 > 10
Also with this patch we have a couple bug fixes that you have been reporting. Thank you for bringing them to our attention.
In old saves, some people not being able to claim pixie rewards now fixed
Pixie friend achievement rechecked on new day for those that didn’t get it unlocked on receiving pixie friend
Fixed final boss homing projectiles still targeting you after being saved by spooklet
Fixed incorrect controller glyph discrepancy between what is shown in controller maps and in-game
Fixed on rare occasions unable to equip or unequip support drone
Word for buy/sell was swapped in Japanese version fixed.
Removed unparsed #NUM# string in Soot Puff description
We are ecstatic to get this patch out to you all! Whether you are a returning player or completely new, now is a great time to dive into Everafter Falls and build your farm.
Riv otter

Hey everyone,

In this patch, there are some huge changes to balance and dungeon difficulty in the later pillars. Drone damage has been increased significantly to try and make attack drones a viable build. Enemy attack has been largely left untouched, but HP has been buffed so players aren’t just mindlessly mowing through the rooms to the final boss.

While this patch has gone some testing and feedback with regards to this, please bear with me if the changes seem too much and post your feedback. I want to get this to a good state of balance where most players face a fun challenge while not being frustratingly hard to progress.

Hey Everyone,
Thanks for your patience with the first post-release patch for Everafter Falls! I’ve been busy working on as many issues as I could, and have addressed the most pressing issues.

A note about this patch for consoles - as the submission and approval times for console are not instant like they are on Steam, it will take around 1 to 2 weeks before this patch makes it to consoles.

For Xbox - we are aware of crashing issues and are working hard to resolve it. I apologize to anyone facing them. A patch (1.0.04) was released to try and address this, but I have still been getting reports that the issue is still there. Please join Discord to and I will post an announcement to notify you when it is fixed.

For Playstation - We are aware of an issue causing saves to get corrupted. If this happens, deleting your save will allow you to start a new game, but the issue may happen again until the bug is fixed. Akupara have been working hard to address this but no luck yet. In the meantime, when the 1.1+ patch hits Playstation, there is an auto-backup and restore feature that will restore the previous days save if corruption has been detected so you lose a day at most.
For Switch - A stability patch has been released v1.0.02 which addresses crashing in the Dungeons. Please note this is not the same as the below patch, which will take a little time to go live.
Thanks so much for everyone’s patience and understanding while we get through the initial launch issues. We hope to resolve them asap.

Highlights from the patch include now full German language support and Non-binary gender selection. The ability to also re-style/re-gender you character in an existing save is also coming in a future patch!
Kind Regards,
Husky
